column1: The canteen biryani today was honestly the best I have had all semester.
My laptop crashed twice during the lab exam and I lost all my work.
The new library timings are really convenient for students who stay late.
That lecture was so boring that half the class fell asleep.
I was pleasantly surprised by how friendly the hostel staff were.
The bus was forty minutes late again and nobody bothered to inform us.
This phone's battery easily lasts two full days and I'm impressed.
The customer support kept me on hold for an hour and then hung up.
